t: What Wildfire Behavior Evidence Database Is All About
title: What Wildfire Behavior Evidence Database Is All About
description: Wildfire behavior is the fire triangle — fuel, weather, topography: the 2018 Camp Fire (85 dead, Paradise destroyed) ran on wind-driven embers through dry fuels; Australia's Black Summer (2019-20) burned 46M acres. Fire behavior models (Rothermel) predict spread from fuel moisture and wind; suppression succeeds at initial attack (~95% of starts) and fails in extreme conditions. The evidence says: manage fuels before the wind comes. This database is the complete fire behavior record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
